name_cn: 河北宝盛纺织品有限公司
main_products: Pocketing fabric, cotton and poly-cotton dyed fabrics, polyester dyed fabric, yarn-dyed fabric, greige
woven_evidence: Its site reports 50M m a year of greige fabric, and its product lines (pocketing, poly-cotton dyed and yarn-dyed fabric) are woven.

canton_fair.evidence_note: Named in the China Textile News report on the 139th Canton Fair. It is also in the 137th Shijiazhuang exhibitor report, and its own site mentions exhibiting at Phase 3 of the 135th fair.

notes: It also lists home textiles and garments. Some site page titles mention non-woven fabric, which may just be SEO wording and needs checking. Its products are OEKO-TEX 100 certified (self-reported).
